about: KeyboardRecs catalog (2026-10-30): the 99 keyboards that moved from GamingRecs (same names, specs and sources, so the same ids and URLs) plus enthusiast keyboards, kits, ergonomic boards, switches and keycaps. Each new entry's exact name was read on the maker's own store or product page (keycaps and switches sold under one product page with colour or weight options are one entry). Columns: shape = category, weight = weight, core = connection, surface = switches, balance = layout. Blank = not read.
